current_episode.title: #185 it’s electric: Beating Tesla Was the Easy Part

guest.bio_context: Tia Gordon's background includes technology work on the 9-11 Memorial and Museum of the World Trade Center, where she worked on approximately 200 layers of embedded technology. She founded It's Electric during the pandemic with an initial cardboard and rubber prototype, which she submitted to Hyundai's Open EV Innovation Challenge and won $300,000 in non-dilutive funding. Her company has since grown to raise $7 million in total non-dilutive funding and a $6.5 million seed round co-led by Uber and fail-up.

pending_qa.q: What is the revenue model and payback timeline for It's Electric chargers?
pending_qa.r: Each charger costs approximately $10,300 all-in after subsidies, with a payback period of around 18 months at 40% utilization. At these rates, a single charger generates approximately $70,000 in lifetime value. This contrasts sharply with fast-charger installations in parking lots, which typically have a 10-year payback.

pending_qa.q: How does It's Electric's public curbside charging address the needs of rideshare drivers versus destination charging?
pending_qa.r: Tia Gordon emphasizes that rideshare drivers lose 20-30% of their weekly revenue searching for chargers and waiting in line. Public curbside charging allows drivers to charge overnight in their own neighborhoods, similar to garage charging for homeowners. This differs from destination charging at parking lots, which requires 6-8 hours and doesn't meet drivers where they live, which is why lot charging has slowed market adoption.

pending_qa.q: What is the current deployment scale across cities where It's Electric operates?
pending_qa.r: It's Electric currently has 54 chargers deployed across six cities (Boston, Detroit, D.C., L.A., San Francisco, and Alameda) over a 10-month period since Uber backed the seed round. The company went from zero curbside chargers on the ground to live operations across these markets while preparing to announce the next two cities over the following quarter.

pending_qa.q: What is the total non-dilutive funding It's Electric has secured and how much has been drawn?
pending_qa.r: It's Electric has been awarded $7 million in total non-dilutive funding but has only drawn down approximately $1.3 million of that amount. The initial $300,000 came from winning Hyundai's Open EV Innovation Challenge, with additional grants awarded since.
